bio: As soon as the doorman ushers you into the luxurious Corinthia Hotel, you will be entranced by its period charm. The restored stained-glass dome of the Palm Court is truly magnificent, while the dining room immerses you in an exquisite Belle époque ambience. A marble fireplace and lovingly restored details set the scene in the spacious restaurant, which also offers privacy and intimacy. David Martin has trained a team that invites you to sample subtle creations enhanced by familiar Japanese flavours in a vibe that is both classy and casual.
